item.title: Moltbook and the Humanless Future of Artificial Intelligence
item.description: Will Saulsbery, an industry-leading A.I. marketer and strategist, and Mark Minevich, a globally recognized chief A.I. officer and investor, examine Moltbook, an experimental A.I.-only social network that places autonomous agents at the center of its ecosystem. They argue that Moltbook is less a provocation than a signal, highlighting how agentic A.I. is moving beyond human-in-the-loop design toward autonomous coordination.
